entries.title: Psalms 139:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.>> O LORD, thou hast searched me, and known [me].

entries.title: Psalms 139:2
segments: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

entries.title: Psalms 139:3
segments: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted [with] all my ways. {compassest: or, winnowest}

entries.title: Psalms 139:4
segments: For [there is] not a word in my tongue, [but], lo, O LORD, thou knowest it altogether.

entries.title: Psalms 139:5
segments: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:6
segments: [Such] knowledge [is] too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot [attain] unto it.

entries.title: Psalms 139:7
segments: ¶Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

entries.title: Psalms 139:8
segments: If I ascend up into heaven, thou [art] there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou [art there].

words.text: , thou [art] there: if I make my bed

entries.title: Psalms 139:9
segments: [If] I take the wings of the morning, [and] dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

entries.title: Psalms 139:10
segments: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:11
segments: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

entries.title: Psalms 139:12
segments: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light [are] both alike [to thee]. {hideth...: Heb. darkeneth not} {the darkness and...: Heb. as is the darkness, so is the light}

words.text: not from thee; but the night
[are] both alike [to thee]. {hideth...: Heb. darkeneth not} {the darkness and...: Heb. as is the darkness, so is the light}

entries.title: Psalms 139:13
segments: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother's womb.

entries.title: Psalms 139:14
segments: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully [and] wonderfully made: marvellous [are] thy works; and [that] my soul knoweth right well. {right...: Heb. greatly}

entries.title: Psalms 139:15
segments: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, [and] curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth. {substance: or, strength, or, body}

words.text: from thee, when I was made

entries.title: Psalms 139:16
segments: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all [my members] were written, [which] in continuance were fashioned, when [as yet there was] none of them. {all...: Heb. all of them} {which...: or, what days they should be fashioned}

words.text: of them. {all...: Heb. all of them} {which...: or, what days they should be fashioned}

entries.title: Psalms 139:17
segments: ¶How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!

entries.title: Psalms 139:18
segments: [If] I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.

words.text: them, they are more in number

entries.title: Psalms 139:19
segments: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.

entries.title: Psalms 139:20
segments: For they speak against thee wickedly, [and] thine enemies take [thy name] in vain.

entries.title: Psalms 139:21
segments: Do not I hate them, O LORD, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

words.text: thee? and am not I grieved

entries.title: Psalms 139:22
segments: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 139:23
segments: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

entries.title: Psalms 139:24
segments: And see if [there be any] wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting. {wicked...: Heb. way of pain, or, grief}

words.text: . {wicked...: Heb. way of pain, or, grief}
